records.productName: LegacyPro EcoPro Ascorbic Acid Powder B&W Film Developer
records.preparation: Dissolve in room-temperature water. Part A must be completely dissolved before adding Part B. Prepare 5 litres and store mixed solution at full strength.
records.shelfLifeStock: Mixed full-strength solution: approximately 6 months in a full tightly sealed container; approximately 2 months in a half-full tightly sealed container.
records.storageNotes: Store mixed solution full strength in a tightly sealed container; air in the storage container reduces shelf life.
records.sourceTitle: LegacyPro Ascorbic Acid Powder B&W Film Developer Processing Instructions

records.productName: B&W PROMICROL Fine Grain Film Developer
records.preparation: For replenished manual or machine processing dilute 1+9. For one-shot manual or machine processing dilute 1+14. Replenisher is prepared by diluting concentrate 1+4.
records.reuseInstructions: At 1+9 the used bath can be replenished. Replenisher addition is 17 ml per 135-36, 15 ml per 120, 30 ml per 220, 4 ml per 4x5 sheet and 16 ml per 8x10 sheet, subject to film type/exposure.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Unopened concentrate: at least 12 months when stored at a steady 13-18 C; avoid storage below 5 C because crystallization may occur.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Machine tank working solutions should not stand unused for more than one week; make no more than one week's replenisher supply at a time.
records.storageNotes: Keep replenisher covered to reduce evaporation, oxidation and contamination.
records.sourceTitle: Champion B&W PROMICROL Fine Grain Film Developer Technical Data Sheet

records.reuseInstructions: Full-strength developer can be reused/replenished. Dilution 1+3 must be mixed immediately before use and discarded after the batch; do not reuse or replenish 1+3.
records.capacityText: Per US gallon of full-strength developer without replenishment: 16 rolls 135-36 or 16 rolls 120; with replenishment: 60 rolls 135-36 or 60 rolls 120. At 1+3, Kodak specifies one 135-36 roll in 473 ml or two rolls in 946 ml.
records.shelfLifeStock: Full-strength stock: 6 months in a full tightly closed bottle; 2 months in a half-filled tightly closed bottle.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Full strength: about 24 hours in a tray or 1 month in a large tank with floating lid. Dilution 1+3: storage/reuse not recommended; prepare immediately before use.
records.sourceTitle: KODAK MICRODOL-X Developer Technical Data J-4027

records.preparation: Variable-dilution developer. Normal dilution range is 1+3 to 1+14; 1+19 may be used for push processing. For replenished automatic machine processing use working solution prepared at approximately 1+4 to 1+5.
records.reuseInstructions: For automatic machine processing the working solution can be replenished at 0.4 ml per square inch of processed film.
records.sourceTitle: Clayton F76 Plus Film Developer Product Bulletin

records.preparation: Dilute concentrate 1+4. Partial mixing of the liquid concentrate is supported by the manufacturer.
records.capacityText: Maximum capacity: 30 rolls of 135-36 per 500 ml concentrate package.
records.sourceTitle: Tetenal Ultrafin T-Plus Information for Retailers and Labs

records.preparation: Dissolve the complete package in water at 70-90 F; do not mix partial container quantities. Distilled water is recommended where mineral content or alkalinity is high.
records.reuseInstructions: With replenisher, add about 1/2 fluid ounce per 80 square inches of film after each batch. Without replenishment, process four rolls at normal times, then increase time 2% for each additional roll, to a maximum of 16 rolls per quart.
records.capacityText: Without replenishment: four rolls at normal times, up to 16 rolls per quart with 2% time increase for each roll after the fourth. Replenishment can continue until an amount equal to the original developer volume has been added.
records.storageNotes: Store in full, tightly capped amber glass or polyethylene bottles to minimize oxidation.
records.sourceTitle: Acufine Developers - Acufine Film Developer Instructions

records.preparation: Prepare the two powders separately as Solution A and Solution B. Dissolve A in 75-85 F water to the package volume and prepare an equal amount of B; keep the two solutions separate and clearly labelled.
records.reuseInstructions: Diafine does not require replenishment and has an unusually long working life when protected from contamination. Maintain solution levels by adding equal amounts of fresh A and B to their respective baths when necessary.
records.storageNotes: Prevent any Solution B from contaminating Solution A. Distilled water is recommended for maximum consistency and stability.
records.sourceTitle: Acufine Developers - Diafine Two-Bath Film Developer Instructions

records.preparation: Prepare stock by dissolving the entire container in one quart of water at 70-90 F. Dilute stock 1+10 or 1+5 according to the manufacturer's film chart.
records.reuseInstructions: Use diluted working solution within four hours of preparation and discard after use.
records.shelfLifeStock: Stock solution: approximately one year when protected from contamination and oxidation.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Diluted working solution: use within four hours, then discard.
records.storageNotes: Store stock in full, tightly capped amber glass or polyethylene bottles; for infrequent use divide into several small bottles.
records.sourceTitle: Acufine Developers - ACU-1 Film Developer Instructions
